author: 4liceD
name: Verification
short: Role-gated CAPTCHA verification for new members.
description: Assign pending roles to new members and require a CAPTCHA solve via persistent verification button before granting access roles.
install_msg: Configure the cog with `[p]verifyset settings` and then post a panel with `[p]verifyset panel`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores temporary verification state (captcha code, attempts, expiry timestamps, and pending timestamps) for members undergoing verification.
